stem: Which sentence best illustrates the narrator's commitment to his project?

options.label: A
options.text: Next morning Little Baldy was a dark hill jutting high into February's cold, windy sky.

options.label: B
options.text: Then, with a hand planter, I planted the corn on moonlit nights.

options.label: C
options.text: We burned the brush and I was ready to start plowing.

options.label: D
options.text: I could not see an object ten feet in front of me in this mist.
